svg.title: ORCA high-level technical system design
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom architecture showing marine stakeholders, interaction and API gateway, agent control plane, multi-source evidence fabric, deterministic intelligence services, and explainable operational outputs.
svg.text: Marine question → trusted evidence → operational action
Captures language, role, location, time and operating context
